[[File:Detective Pikachu EN logo.png|thumb|Logo of the first game.]] The '''Detective Pikachu series''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|名探偵|めいたんてい}}ピカチュウ''' ''Great Detective Pikachu'') is a series of cinematic action-adventure {{spin-off games}} developed by [[Creatures, Inc.|Creatures]]. The series includes two games and several adaptations, including a live-action film, an animated short, a graphic novel, and multiple novelizations. The premise of the series involves the titular {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|character}} and his partner [[Tim Goodman]], who is uniquely able to understand Pikachu's words. The duo collaborate with both people and Pokémon to solve mysteries, and search for Tim's missing father [[Harry Goodman]]. The series has two distinct continuities: one for the [[Detective Pikachu (video game)|original game]] and [[Detective Pikachu Returns|its sequel]], and one for the {{DetPikMov|live-action movie}}. ==History== The first game was [[n:NHK documentary reveals new games in development|initially revealed]], though not yet named, in an ''{{wp|NHK|NHK Professional: Shigoto no Ryuugi}}'' documentary featuring [[Tsunekazu Ishihara]] aired on October 28, 2013. The game would be officially announced on January 26, 2016 as [[Detective Pikachu (video game)|Detective Pikachu – Birth of a New Duo]], which contained the first three chapters of the story, and would only be released in Japan. On January 12, 2018, a full version of the game titled {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|video game}} and containing all nine chapters was announced, including an international release. A prequel book, ''[[Detective Pikachu: Episode 0—Eevee's Case]]'', was released with the game on March 23, 2018. A live-action movie loosely based on the first game, titled {{DetPikMov}}, was also released on May 10, 2019. While the movie's premise is very similar to that of the first game, its events diverge significantly. Development of a second game would be announced at the May 2019 [[Pokémon Presents#May 29, 2019|Pokémon Press Conference]][https://youtu.be/vTWkBjxvBok?t=412 ''2019 Pokémon Press Conference'' - The Official Pokémon YouTube channel] (retrieved June 21, 2023), however no further information would be released until 2023, where the game was revealed with a trailer as [[Detective Pikachu Returns]] in the June 2023 [[Nintendo Direct]]. The game would release worldwide on October 6, 2023. Shortly afterwards on October 25, 2023, an animated short using the second game's character designs, [[Detective Pikachu & the Mystery of the Missing Flan]], would be released online. ==Gameplay== The [[player]], as [[Tim Goodman]], explores 3D environments, where they can examine objects and interview witnesses (both human and Pokémon) for information about a mystery in the area. Notes about the case are recorded in Tim's notebook, and can be accessed at any time. {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|character}} can discuss the case with Tim, and will ask questions that require making deductions from the evidence and testimony Tim has gathered. Answering these questions correctly will trigger events that advance the story. Some chapters additionally have confrontation scenes, where Tim gathers all of the suspects of a case together, and dramatically identifies the culprit while explaining his findings. The games use a large amount of fully-voiced cutscenes to tell their stories. Cards from this expansion were uniquely not viewable or markable as owned in [[Pokémon TCG Card Dex]] until they were scanned.
